latin: Per aliam uitam in Epinomide intelligere debemus connexionem partis cum suo toto, et credo idem esse quod apud Cabalistas dicitur saeculum uenturum.
translation: The 'other life' mentioned in the Epinomis refers, I take it, to how a part is bound up with its whole—and this, I believe, is the very thing the Cabalists mean by the world to come.
